question: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated PARAM Rudra Supercomputer at which of the following places in September 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** inaugurated the **PARAM Rudra Supercomputer** in **September 2024**.
 
• The event took place in **Kolkata**, a major city in the eastern part of **India**.
